VALID-01.name: Match the analytical task to field meaning
VALID-01.requirement: A finite operation accepts only its declared semantic roles and complete distinct fields.

SOURCE-01.name: Keep the marks attached to their evidence
SOURCE-01.requirement: Chart, observation, table and replay consume the same result artifact; selection uses exact series/index mappings.

SUPPORT-01.name: Expose support and missing information
SUPPORT-01.requirement: Show the recorded support, missing values, sample status and omitted groups. Group comparisons need declared minimum support.

SCALE-01.name: Use a scale appropriate to the comparison
SCALE-01.requirement: Magnitude bars include zero; log ordinates require positive values; proportions use a declared domain; temporal gaps stay missing.

ORDER-01.name: Preserve meaningful category order
ORDER-01.requirement: Declared ordinal order takes precedence over a frequency ranking.

AGG-01.name: Show what a summary leaves out
AGG-01.requirement: Means are paired with support or distribution views. Bin and period comparisons are diagnostic views, not automatic robustness verdicts.

MODEL-01.name: Evaluate on held-out rows
MODEL-01.requirement: Train-only preprocessing, fixed baselines, explicit memberships and source-linked errors precede any model-derived finding. Prediction does not establish causality.

HYPOTHESIS-01.name: Compute before interpreting a visual hypothesis
HYPOTHESIS-01.requirement: A model may propose an eligible check or abstain. Python executes it; generated prose remains labeled interpretation and cannot add measured quantities.

SEM-VALID.name: Make semantic eligibility executable
SEM-VALID.requirement: Metric field dependencies, role permissions and finite parameters must match their typed definition.

SEM-GRAIN.name: Declare the analytical unit
SEM-GRAIN.requirement: Recorded rows, distinct entities and repeated entity-valued amounts require different definitions.

SEM-AGG.name: Recompose from valid components
SEM-AGG.requirement: Recompute ratios, weighted means, Other and temporal aggregates from their recorded components. Do not sum rates or daily stocks.

SEM-DENOM.name: Check membership before claiming composition
SEM-DENOM.requirement: The denominator population, missing identity and overlapping membership must be explicit; incidence may exceed a complete composition.

SEM-MEANING.name: Separate proposal from declaration
SEM-MEANING.requirement: Observed values and names can propose meanings; only confirmed operational definitions authorize conditional business summaries.

SEM-SCOPE.name: Scope evidence to its contract and population
SEM-SCOPE.requirement: Semantic revisions invalidate dependent work. Pins and replay retain the original definition and source memberships.

SEM-TIME.name: Model the observation process
SEM-TIME.requirement: Missing observations are unknown until a compatible schedule, process, coverage and bounded fill policy have been declared.

SEM-UNIT.name: Validate transformation domain and origin
SEM-UNIT.requirement: Transformations follow aggregation and require permission, a valid numerical domain and a compatible reference origin.

SEM-MODEL.name: Match validation to declared generalization
SEM-MODEL.requirement: Respect repeated-entity holdout and prediction-time availability for every predictive provider.

EXP-COMP.name: Keep the comparison coherent
EXP-COMP.requirement: Record the reference, cohort and denominator; compare stable category identities with compatible scales and bins. Preserve original definitions in saved boards.
EXP-COMP.evidence: Few Part II Chapters 5, 10–11; Gleicher et al. 2011; few-part-ii-review.md R19. Comparison layout remains a design choice, not a measured productivity result.

EXP-SHAPE.name: Inspect center, spread and shape separately
EXP-SHAPE.requirement: Zero signed association or a flat conditional median does not establish independence. Preserve quartiles, support and the recorded pairs; do not infer clusters or causes from appearance.
EXP-SHAPE.evidence: Few Part II Chapters 6 and 9; Matejka and Fitzmaurice 2017; independent variance-only counterexamples.

EXP-SCOPE.name: Separate calculation from display approximation
EXP-SCOPE.requirement: Report statistics, displayed marks and review reductions separately. CDF compression certifies vertical error; exact threshold queries use source values. Endpoint extensions have no source members.
EXP-SCOPE.evidence: Mathematical definition and independent source-threshold oracles in few-part-ii-probes.json and test_exploration.py; not a visual-salience experiment.

EXP-TIME.name: Retain chronological and observation context
EXP-TIME.requirement: Show raw evidence alongside complete-window or calendar companions. Preserve unknown dates, compatible reference bases and original values; smoothing and recurring phase do not establish a forecast.
EXP-TIME.evidence: Few Part II Chapter 8; Forecasting: Principles and Practice, graphics and decomposition; engineering completeness limits are explicit.

CHART-ZERO.name: Magnitude bars include zero, including facets
CHART-ZERO.requirement: Magnitude bars and facet bars include zero; a shared truncated domain is still invalid.

CHART-CORRELATION-DOMAIN.name: Correlation bounds do not apply to every dot plot
CHART-CORRELATION-DOMAIN.requirement: Correlation summaries use [-1, 1]; generic dot plots retain the actual quantity domain.

CHART-SCATTER-ASPECT.name: Square scatter area does not equate data units
CHART-SCATTER-ASPECT.requirement: Use a square scatter plot area without implying that one x unit equals one y unit.

CHART-AREA-PARTS.name: Area marks need valid parts and a recorded whole
CHART-AREA-PARTS.requirement: Area sizes are finite and nonnegative with a positive whole; zero-area parts remain disclosed.
CHART-AREA-PARTS.evidence: Few (2020), Ch 5, pp 118-119; First Look executable semantic, chart and source-membership contracts

CHART-HISTOGRAM-INTERVALS.name: Histogram geometry preserves numeric intervals
CHART-HISTOGRAM-INTERVALS.requirement: Histogram columns preserve equal contiguous numeric intervals, including empty bins; no fake gaps.

CHART-REFERENCE-QUANTITY.name: Reference lines name the compared quantity
CHART-REFERENCE-QUANTITY.requirement: Differences reference zero; compatible Q-Q values reference identity y=x, not a fitted regression.

CHART-RESIDUAL-COLOR.name: Signed residual color has a neutral zero
CHART-RESIDUAL-COLOR.requirement: Signed residuals use a diverging scale centred at zero; counts use a sequential scale.

CHART-BOX-CONVENTION.name: Range and Tukey boxes are declared conventions
CHART-BOX-CONVENTION.requirement: Declare min/quartiles/median/max for a range box; Tukey whiskers and outliers require their own definition.
CHART-BOX-CONVENTION.evidence: Few (2020), Ch 6, pp 151-153; First Look executable semantic, chart and source-membership contracts

CHART-TIME-GAPS.name: Timestamp spacing and unknown observations persist
CHART-TIME-GAPS.requirement: Preserve timestamp spacing and unknown gaps; filling needs the existing scoped semantic permission.
CHART-TIME-GAPS.evidence: Few (2020), Ch 8, pp 179-189, 196-200; First Look executable semantic, chart and source-membership contracts

CHART-SOURCE-MEMBERSHIP.name: Every selectable mark preserves source contributors
CHART-SOURCE-MEMBERSHIP.requirement: Keep exact source contributors and sampling scope; display-only reference geometry creates no observations.
CHART-SOURCE-MEMBERSHIP.evidence: First Look executable semantic, chart and source-membership contracts

scope: The studies motivate conditional design patterns. Thresholds and budgets are engineering choices; this integrated app has not undergone a user study. Few's corpus is expert guidance, not one experimentally validated universal algorithm.
